diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~129% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.076), which favours a robust combination.
